country: # Puck Bay (Zatoka Pucka): shallow flat water inside the Hel peninsula
region: Poland's kite centre with many schools.

name: Rewa
notes: Puck Bay at the Rewa spit: shallow flat water, schools on site. Also: Puck town beach (Puck Bay flat water, schools).

name: Chałupy (Hel Peninsula)
notes: Puck Bay side: shallow flat water, the main kite area of the peninsula with many schools and campsites. Busy in summer. Also: Kuźnica, between Chałupy and Jastarnia (same flat water, schools).

name: Jastarnia (Hel Peninsula)
notes: Puck Bay side: shallow flat water, kite schools.

name: Dębki
notes: Open Baltic beach: waves in N–NW winds, for confident riders.

name: Łeba
notes: Open Baltic beach: waves in onshore winds, for confident riders.
